llm.summary: The skill’s purpose is coherent, but its install instructions run unpinned code from an external GitHub repository that was not included in the reviewed artifact.

dimensions.detail: Running an npm script from the remote repository gives that repository’s current contents local code-execution authority in the user environment, while the reviewed package contains only Markdown documentation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation tells the user to clone https://github.com/dongsheng123132/2origin.git and immediately run npm run verify without a pinned commit, signature, checksum, or bundled reviewed implementation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime examples are scoped to user-named .origin packages and documented transaction files, with no artifact-backed prompt hijacking, credential handling, exfiltration, or destructive instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally creates persistent .origin project-state files and can run an MCP server against a chosen package, but it does not show system-level persistence, startup hooks, privilege escalation, or background installation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact describes a persistent .origin project-state protocol with provenance, semantic transactions, local CLI commands, and optional MCP integration; these capabilities fit the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review or sandbox the external repository before following the install steps. Prefer a pinned commit with an independently verified checksum or signature, and run npm scripts only in a disposable environment without secrets or broad filesystem access.
llm.findings: [T03] unexpected: The scanner concern is supported by the artifact: the install block retrieves a mutable remote repository and runs npm run verify. Cloning an implementation is related to the purpose, but executing unpinned, unreviewed remote code is under-scoped for a reviewed skill package.
